content: Parahuni heinɨtsikateya
Merikɨtsɨ huta wiyari 'anukayaku, Parahuni mɨpaɨ katiniuheinɨni: Niru hatuxameyari tetsita kaniuwekaitɨni.
Yapauka hapa mekanatinexɨani, 'atahuta meyupaɨmetɨ wakaitsixi mewaiyatɨkaitɨ, mekatenikwatɨwekaitɨni makutsiɨraɨyetsie.
Hikɨ wa'utɨmata mekanatinexɨani, wahepaɨ meyupaɨmetɨ, mewawakitɨ 'axameteyuxexeiyatɨ, mana mekaniti'uni memɨwaiyatɨka wa'aurie Niru hatetsitayaritsie.
Wakaitsixi memɨwawaki mekaniwarutikwani memɨwaiyatɨka. 'Anari Parahuni kananutaniere.
Hutariekata kaneukuni. 'Ana tawarita pɨtiuheinɨ. Tɨriku xeikɨyeyaritsie 'uye'ukame puxei kɨkɨreme witsi'aneneme.
'Utɨmanata kanixeiya, hepaɨna paɨmeme wawakime 'eka mɨxɨkakɨ.
'Atahuta tɨriku mɨwawaki kanitikwani tɨriku mɨkɨkɨre witsimɨ'anene. 'Ana Parahuni kananutaniere, mɨpaɨ retimaika mɨheinɨtsikatɨkaikɨ.
Nutuixietɨ yu'iyaritɨatɨ ximeri kananukukeni. Katiniwarutanɨ'airieni 'awie temaiwawemete 'ekipitutari. Katiniwarutaxatɨani kemɨtiuheinɨ, peru nixewitɨ pɨka'itahekɨatɨa heinɨtsikaya.
Hikɨ tewi tekɨxi 'uitɨwamete mɨtiwa'aitɨa, mɨpaɨ Parahuni katiniutahɨawe: «Neuxei, nepaye'eri ke'axanemɨtiuyuri.
Kepauka Parahuni muyeha'a teyu'uximayatsiriwamete wahekɨ, kuyaxi mɨtiwa'aitɨa katananutaxɨrieni ne meta paa wewiwame.
Xeime tɨkaritsie taxexuitɨ tepɨte'uheinɨ, xexuitɨ peixeiyakai heinɨtsika kemɨti'ayumiemetɨkai.
Hikɨ xewitɨ tahamatɨa payekatei, temaikɨtɨtɨ Hepɨrayu tewiyari kuyaxi mɨtiwa'aitɨa mɨparewiekai. Tepitaxatɨa ketemɨte'uheinɨ. Mɨkɨ pɨtatsi'utahekɨatɨa xexuime.
Naitɨ yapɨraye'a mɨkɨ kemɨtatiutaxatɨa. Ne hutarieka nepuhɨritɨarie ne'uximayatsika, xewitɨta pumierie kɨyetsie».
Hikɨ ti'aitame Kutse katiniutanɨ'airieni. 'Ana kwitɨ kaniwayexɨnarieni katsariyanata. Kwitɨ 'uyutikemaritɨaka, kaninuani Parahuni hɨxie.
Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katinitaxatɨani: —Ne nepɨtiuheinɨ, xewitɨ pɨka'ihekɨatawe. Peru xewitɨ pɨnetiutaxatɨa, kename 'ekɨ peyɨwe pemitahekɨata heinɨtsi.
Hikɨ Kutse kanita'eiya: —Ne nepɨkahɨkɨ. Kakaɨyari kanihɨkɨtɨni mitahekɨata.
Hikɨ ti'aitame Parahuni Kutse mɨpaɨ katiniutaxatɨani: —Neheinɨtsita, Niru hatuxameyari tetsita nepuwekai.
Hikɨ yapauka hapa mekanatinexɨani, 'atahuta meyɨpaɨmetɨ wakaitsixi mewaiyatɨkaitɨ, witsime'anenetɨ 'ɨxapa mekatenikwatɨwekaitɨni.
Yapaukata wa'utɨma mekanatinexɨani wahepaɨ meyupaɨmetɨ, mewawakitɨ 'axameteyuxexeiyatɨ. Hatsuaku kenemɨkatiwaxeiyawekai mɨpaɨ me'aneneme 'Ekipitutsie.
Kwitɨwata 'atahuta wakaitsixi memɨwawaki, mekaniwarutikwani memɨwaiyatɨka.
Tsepa memɨwarutikwakai, yaxeikɨa mepɨtewawakikai. 'Ana nepanutanierixɨ.
»Hutariekata nepɨtiuheinɨ, 'atahutame nepuxei tɨriku mɨayeyari kɨkɨreme witsi'aneneme, pɨwawerekai xeikɨyeyaritsie tiwiyatɨ.
'Utɨmanata nepixei, hepaɨna paɨmeme tɨriku wawakime 'eka mɨxɨkakɨ.
Tɨriku mɨwawaki 'aixɨa mɨ'anene kaniutikwani. 'Ikɨ naime nepɨwarutaxatɨa 'awie temaiwawemete peru nixewitɨ pɨkanetsi'utahekɨatɨa».
Hikɨ Kutse kanitahekɨatɨani naime kemɨtiuheinɨkai Parahuni. Mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Puyuxewitɨtɨ kepemɨtiuheinɨ. Kakaɨyari kanihɨkɨtɨni mɨmatiutahekɨatɨa kemɨtiyɨni.
Mɨkɨ matsi 'atahuta wakaitsixi memɨwaiyatɨka, yaxeikɨa tɨriku mɨkɨkɨre, mɨkɨ 'atahuta wiyari pɨ'inɨariyari. Mɨkɨ puyuxewi heinɨtsika.
Wakaitsixi 'atahuta memɨwawaki 'axamemɨ'anene, memɨwaiyatɨka wa'utɨa mematinexɨa, meta 'atahuta tɨriku 'etsimɨpepe mɨwawaki 'eka mɨxɨkakɨ, mɨkɨta pɨhɨkɨ 'atahuta wiyari. Mɨpaɨ paɨmexa haakaxa payani.
»Kenemɨmarahɨawe Parahuni, yurikɨ Kakaɨyari kemɨmatihekɨatɨa, pɨtihekɨata kemɨtiyurieni.
'Anari kanaye'amɨkɨ, 'atahuta wiyari waɨkawa mɨtitixuawere 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie.
Hepaɨna paɨmetɨ mahu, haakaxa payani, 'anari pɨkatitixuawere, mepɨtehatɨmaiyani waɨkawa kememɨtehexeiyakai meripaitɨ mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie.
Yemekɨ waɨkawa haakaxa payani keyamɨkatiyɨwekai meripaitɨ.
'Ekɨ Parahuni hutame pemuheinɨ, Kakaɨyari puyumexɨitɨa kwitɨwa mɨpaɨ mɨtiyurienikɨ.
»'Ayumieme, hikɨ Parahuni xeime keneutiwawa waɨkawa yɨweme, timaiweme, pemihɨritɨanikɨ 'Ekipitu kwieyari hepaɨtsita.

'Ekɨ Parahuni mɨpaɨ ketineuyuri, keniwarutihɨawi nenieremete naitsarie 'Ekipitu, 'atahuta wiyari waɨkawa mɨtitixuawere 'itsanari 'auxɨwimexɨa tixeɨriekame, xeime xemɨti'utakɨ Parahuni hetsiemieme, naitsarie 'akwiepa.
'Ekɨ Parahuni peti'aitakaku, mɨkɨ nenieremete meke'ikuxeɨrieni 'ikwai 'aixɨa mɨtixuaweretsie mieme, meke'iti'uta naitsarie kiekaritetsie, 'ikwai xemexeiyanikɨ mɨtiumawenitsie.
Mɨkɨ 'ikwai mɨti'utsieni 'Ekipitutsie mieme payani, 'atahuta wiyari mɨhaakaxatɨnitsie, mɨpaɨ teɨteri mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie haakakɨ mepɨkakwini».
Hikɨ Parahuni 'iyarieya 'aixɨa kaniuyɨni Kutse kemɨtitahekɨatɨa, yaxeikɨata 'iparewiwametemama.
Hikɨ Parahuni mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'iwawiya memiparewiekai: —Kamɨtsɨ hakewa tepeikaxeiya xeime 'ikɨ hepaɨ 'anekame, Kakaɨyari 'iyarieya hexeiyame.
Hikɨ ti'aitame Kutse mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Mɨpaɨ nepɨretima Kakaɨyari pɨmatihekɨatɨa 'ikɨ naime, xewitɨ pumawe yɨwetɨ, timaiwetɨ, 'ahepaɨ.
'Ekɨ nepɨmatsihɨritɨani nemɨra'aitatsie, neteɨterima yamepɨtekakɨne 'ekɨ petiwa'aitɨakaku. Ne xeikɨa matsi nemɨmariwe nepɨhɨkɨtɨni, nemɨti'aitamekɨ.
Kutse kemɨti'aitakai 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie
Hikɨ Parahuni mɨpaɨ Kutse katiniutaxatɨani: —Hikɨ ne nepumatsihɨritɨa 'Ekipitu kwieyari naime.
'Ana kwitɨwa Parahuni yuhanira 'anutihɨnaka Kutse 'itɨwameyatsie kanekamanirieni, katiniuta'aita memenakatɨtɨanikɨ kamixa witsimɨ'ane meta huru kukayari mepetitɨtɨa kɨipitɨana.
Hikɨ yuparewiwame kaxetayatsie kanenutiyeni, teparewiwamete me'utihiwakaku ya'ane mewapitɨakaku yunaitɨ mekaniukatunuma'uwekaitɨni hɨxiena. Kanihɨritɨani 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie naime.
Hikɨ Parahuni mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Ne ti'aitame Parahuni nepɨhɨkɨ, peru xewitɨ 'Ekipitutsie yapɨkatiyurieni 'ekɨ yapekahainekaku.
Hikɨ kanipata kemɨtitewakai, Tsapenati-Paneha katiniterɨwa. 'Uka kaniwitɨtɨani 'Atsenati titewakame, Putipera niweya mawari wewiwame 'Uni kiekame. Mɨpaɨ katinanukakeni Kutse 'Ekipitu ti'aitatɨ.
Xeitewiyari heimana tamamata kanihɨkaitɨni Kutse kepauka mɨtiukatsutɨa ti'uximayatɨ ti'aitame tsiemieme. Kutse Parahuni hɨxie kaniutateuta, kaneyani 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie, kanikuniere.
Mɨkɨ 'atahuta wiyaritsie 'aixɨa mɨtiwiyekekaitsie, 'ana waɨkawa katiniutixuawere.
Hikɨ Kutse katiniuti'uta naime tikwaiwamete, mɨkɨ 'atahuta wiyaritsie mieme katiniuti'uta kiekaritsie.
Kutse tɨriku puti'utaxɨ xiekari muti'uta hepaɨ, pɨtiyuxexeiyakai mi'inɨatakai pɨtiuhayewaxɨ mɨkayu'inɨatsinɨakaikɨ.
Mexɨakame ka'anuyeyeiwekaku haakaxa wiyari, Kutse tɨɨri yuhutame mepɨwarayexei 'Atsenati matɨa, Putipera mawari wewiwame niweya 'Uni kiekame.
Yumatɨari Manatsexi katiniuterɨwa mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka: «Kakaɨyari pɨtiyuriene nemɨratɨmaiyakɨ naime 'uximatɨarikakɨ nekie hakewa nemetinuiwaxɨ».
Hutarieka mieme 'Epɨrahini pɨtiterɨwaxɨ mɨpaɨ 'utayɨka: «Kakaɨyari pɨnetsi'upitɨa nemɨxiɨkakɨ, 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie hakewa nemɨreka'eniwakai».
Hikɨ 'atahuta wiyari 'aixɨa mɨtiwiyekekaitsie kanaye'ani.
Kutse kemutayɨkai haakaxa kaniuyutsutɨani 'atahuta wiyari, haakaxa kanayani naitsarie kwie mumanetɨkateitsie. 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie xeikɨa puxuawekai, Kutse mɨtiuta'aitakaikɨ mɨtiti'utsienikɨ.

Kepauka 'ekipitutari memuhaakakwi, teɨteri Parahuni hetsɨa mekaniye'axɨani 'ikwai mete'iwawirietɨ, hikɨ Parahuni mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe teɨteri 'ekipitutari: «Xekenehu Kutse hetsɨa yaxeketenekakɨni kemetayɨni».
Kepauka yuwaɨkawatɨ memɨyehaakakwitɨwekai, Kutse katineuyepieni tɨriku mɨwa'utɨkaitsie watuirienike 'ekipitutari.
Yaxeikɨata 'ateewa paitɨ meheyekɨkatɨ 'Ekipitu mekani'axekaitɨni, tɨriku mekunanetɨwetɨ Kutse hetsɨa, mɨhaakaxatɨkaikɨ kwinimieme naitsarie kwie kemɨyewa.
